Network Title: Northwest Territories – Department of Environment and Climate Change, Climate Monitoring Network

Domain: Weather

Network Type: Atmospheric: Surface

Network Provider: Northwest Territories Department of Department of Environment and Climate Change

Network Provider Website: https://www.gov.nt.ca/ecc/en

Station Automation: Automated

Highest Sampling Frequency: Hourly

Data Feed Frequency: Mixed

Period of Operation (Seasonal or Continuous): Continuous

Number of Stations: 17 stations in 15 locations

Category of Reported Elements: Temperature; Humidity; Rainfall; Snow depth; Wind speed; Wind direction; Radiation

Data Access Points: https://dd.weather.gc.ca/today/observations/swob-ml/partners/nt-water/

Quality Assessed (Yes/No): N/A

Legal Constraints: N/A
